definitions: To increase the price of something for sale.
To add notes, corrections, or other markings to a text or document.
To prepare a document with special codes or tags to indicate formatting or structure (especially in computing).
examples: The store decided to mark up the designer bags by 20%.
Please mark up the essay with any errors you find.
The editor will mark up the manuscript with the necessary changes.
You need to mark up the web page with HTML tags.
